dialogues.jp:
本屋にでも寄ってみるか、とぷらぷら商店街へ
足を向ける。
dialogues.en:
I aimlessly skimmed the magazines at one of the bookstores
of the shopping district.
dialogues.text:
I aimlessly skimmed the magazines at one of the bookstores
of the shopping district.

dialogues.jp: 特に目当ての本があるわけではないのだが。
dialogues.en: I didn't have any particular book in mind.
dialogues.text: I didn't have any particular book in mind.

dialogues.jp: （今日は水曜か……なんか雑誌出てたっけ）
dialogues.en: "(Today's Wednesday... the magazines should be out today.)"
dialogues.text: "(Today's Wednesday... the magazines should be out today.)"

dialogues.jp:
見慣れた「すばる書店」の看板を眺めつつ、
ぼーっと考えていると、向こうからやって来
る奴らが……。
dialogues.en:
I looked at the now-familiar "Subaru Bookstore" sign, and
thought about whether to go in, when I sensed something
coming...
dialogues.text:
I looked at the now-familiar "Subaru Bookstore" sign, and
thought about whether to go in, when I sensed something
coming...

dialogues.jp: 「むむっ」
dialogues.en: "Damnit..."
dialogues.text: "Damnit..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は思わず電柱のかげに身を隠す。
dialogues.en: I instinctively hid behind a nearby streetlamp.
dialogues.text: I instinctively hid behind a nearby streetlamp.

dialogues.jp:
そっと息を潜める俺。近づいてきた足音がすぐ
そばで止まった。
dialogues.en:
I held my breath. The footsteps, growing louder and louder,
suddenly came to a stop.
dialogues.text:
I held my breath. The footsteps, growing louder and louder,
suddenly came to a stop.

dialogues.jp: 大丈夫、見られてはいなかったはずだ。
dialogues.en: It should be okay, he can't see me.
dialogues.text: It should be okay, he can't see me.

dialogues.jp: そうは思うが、自然と鼓動が早くなる。
dialogues.en: But as I thought that, my heartbeat quickened.
dialogues.text: But as I thought that, my heartbeat quickened.

dialogues.jp:
「フッ……隠れても無駄だ、大人しく手をあげ
　て出て来い」
dialogues.en: "Heh... there's no use in hiding. Come out like a man."
dialogues.text: "Heh... there's no use in hiding. Come out like a man."

dialogues.jp: と、頭に銃口を突きつけられた。
dialogues.en: I felt a gun muzzle grazing my head.
dialogues.text: I felt a gun muzzle grazing my head.

dialogues.jp:
「ＯＫ、わかった。金はやる、そのかわり命だ
　けは助けてくれ」
dialogues.en:
"OK, I got it. I'd give you all my money as long as you
spare my life."
dialogues.text:
"OK, I got it. I'd give you all my money as long as you
spare my life."

dialogues.jp:
俺は思わず苦笑をもらし、ホールドアップしな
がらそう言った。
dialogues.en: I smiled wryly, putting my hands up in the air.
dialogues.text: I smiled wryly, putting my hands up in the air.

dialogues.jp: ……まさか気づかれていたとはな。
dialogues.en: ...What if this really was that situation.
dialogues.text: ...What if this really was that situation.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「………………なーにやってんだよ」
dialogues.en: "........What ARE you two doing..."
dialogues.text: "........What ARE you two doing..."

dialogues.jp:
そこで、｛ぼうかんしゃ／傍観者｝、工藤少年の｛さ／醒｝めたツッコミが
入る。
dialogues.en: The bystander, Tsukkomi Kudou, entered the scene.
dialogues.text: The bystander, Tsukkomi Kudou, entered the scene.

dialogues.jp:
そこには、銃口に見立てた人差し指を頭につき
つけられている俺がいた。
dialogues.en:
He poked his finger into the head of the person holding me
at gunpoint.
dialogues.text:
He poked his finger into the head of the person holding me
at gunpoint.

dialogues.jp: 突きつけているのはもちろん杉並だ。
dialogues.en: Of course, that person was Suginami.
dialogues.text: Of course, that person was Suginami.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ノリの悪い奴め……この場合お前の役所は
　犯人人質問わずにパーンとやっちまうダー
　ティーな保安官だろう」
dialogues.en:
"Damn it all... who would've expected you dirty fuzz to be
foiling my hostage-taking?"
dialogues.text:
"Damn it all... who would've expected you dirty fuzz to be
foiling my hostage-taking?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「だから、どういう設定なんだっての」
dialogues.en: "As I will keep on saying, what ARE you two doing."
dialogues.text: "As I will keep on saying, what ARE you two doing."

dialogues.jp:
口調と声は呆れているが、俺ら二人のバカは今
に始まったことじゃないのと分かっているのか
工藤の顔は笑っていた。
dialogues.en:
Kudou's voice sounded shocked, but he was laughing as well.
This certainly wasn't the first time he had seen us like
this.
dialogues.text:
Kudou's voice sounded shocked, but he was laughing as well.
This certainly wasn't the first time he had seen us like
this.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……だいたい何故俺達の姿を見てコソコソす
　る？」
dialogues.en: "...Anyway, why were you all stealth-like when you saw us?"
dialogues.text: "...Anyway, why were you all stealth-like when you saw us?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いや、あんまりお前らと会ってて、何かのフ
　ラグが立っても困りものだなと……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I was afraid if we met, it would trigger a route flag
that I didn't want to happen..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I was afraid if we met, it would trigger a route flag
that I didn't want to happen..."

dialogues.jp:
杉並・工藤・俺、三つ巴ラヴラヴトライアング
ルＥＮＤとかな……。
dialogues.en:
The love triangle ending with Suginami, Kudou and I, that
is...
dialogues.text:
The love triangle ending with Suginami, Kudou and I, that
is...

dialogues.jp:
自分で言っておいてなんだが、激しくご遠慮願
いたい。
dialogues.en:
Following my words, I ferverently prayed that what I said
would not happen.
dialogues.text:
Following my words, I ferverently prayed that what I said
would not happen.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「それもまた一興」
dialogues.en: "That would be...interesting."
dialogues.text: "That would be...interesting."

dialogues.jp:
目を細めてにやりとする杉並に背筋あたりが寒
くなる。
dialogues.en:
Suginami's back hunched slightly, shivers running through
his soldiers.
dialogues.text:
Suginami's back hunched slightly, shivers running through
his soldiers.

dialogues.jp: こちらとしては、心の底から願い下げだ。
dialogues.en: I continued praying from the bottom of my heart.
dialogues.text: I continued praying from the bottom of my heart.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ま、折角だからこのまま三人でゲーセンへで
　もなだれ込もうではないか」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, since we're gathered now, let's go to the game
center."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, since we're gathered now, let's go to the game
center."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前のことだ、別に本屋に用があったわけで
　もあるまい」
dialogues.en:
"That is, if you don't have anything to do at the
bookstore."
dialogues.text:
"That is, if you don't have anything to do at the
bookstore."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……まぁな」
dialogues.en: "...Nah, nothing."
dialogues.text: "...Nah, nothing."

dialogues.jp:
この男に行動パターンを読まれているのがなん
だか悔しい気もするが、確かに用事があるわけ
ではないので頷き返す。
dialogues.en:
This person hardly ever changes his patterns, but since I
had nothing to do anyway, I accepted.
dialogues.text:
This person hardly ever changes his patterns, but since I
had nothing to do anyway, I accepted.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「フフフ…………今日こそはお前をコートに沈
　めてやろう」
dialogues.en: "Fufufu... I'd wipe you out on the court today."
dialogues.text: "Fufufu... I'd wipe you out on the court today."

dialogues.jp:
杉並の手が、エアホッケーのスマッシャーをつ
まむ仕草になる。
dialogues.en: Suginami mimicked smashing an air hockey puck with his hand.
dialogues.text: Suginami mimicked smashing an air hockey puck with his hand.

dialogues.jp: 「その言葉――今に後悔させてやるぜ」
dialogues.en: "You'd regret saying those words."
dialogues.text: "You'd regret saying those words."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……懲りない奴らだな」
dialogues.en: "Sigh... you two never learn."
dialogues.text: "Sigh... you two never learn."

dialogues.jp: また始まった、と言いたげに頭を抱える工藤。
dialogues.en:
It's starting again, Kudou implied, as he held his head with
his hands.
dialogues.text:
It's starting again, Kudou implied, as he held his head with
his hands.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「逃げるなよ、審判！」
dialogues.en: "Don't run away, ref!"
dialogues.text: "Don't run away, ref!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、はいはい」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, got it, got it."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, got it, got it."

dialogues.jp:
そして俺達は――というか、俺と杉並は意気揚々
と、工藤は仕方なく、ゲーセンへと繰り出すの
だった。
dialogues.en:
So, in high spirits, we--well, Suginami and I, and a
resigned Kudou, headed forth to the game centre.
dialogues.text:
So, in high spirits, we--well, Suginami and I, and a
resigned Kudou, headed forth to the game centre.

dialogues.jp: ◆いつもどおりの遭遇◆
dialogues.en: ◆Everday Encounters◆
dialogues.text: ◆Everday Encounters◆

dialogues.jp: 本屋の前で杉並と工藤に遭遇した。
dialogues.en:
I had an encounter with Suginami and Kudou in front of the
bookshop.
dialogues.text:
I had an encounter with Suginami and Kudou in front of the
bookshop.

dialogues.jp:
その後、三人でいつものように、ゲーセンへと
繰り出すのだった。
dialogues.en: After that, as usual, we headed forth to the game centre.
dialogues.text: After that, as usual, we headed forth to the game centre.
